data.one_liner: Dart plugin to parse HLS m3u8 master and media playlist files.
data.what_it_does: Parses HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) m3u8 playlist files into structured Dart objects. Supports both master playlists and media playlists, handling a wide range of standard HLS tags.
use_when: You need to parse HLS m3u8 playlists manually in Flutter or Dart.
You are building a custom video player logic that requires reading master or media stream attributes.
avoid_when: You only need a high-level video player widget without inspecting raw playlist structures.
Your project relies heavily on unsupported tags such as EXT-X-DATERANGE or EXT-X-SERVER-CONTROL.
strengths: Supports both master and media HLS playlist files.
Null-safe implementation with a clean API.
weaknesses: Some HLS tags are not supported.
Does not play video on its own, purely a parser.
